args.name: Prepare a substantial meal
args.function: Prepare gathered edible ingredients into a substantial meal using a reusable food-preparation skill.
args.conditions: I know berries and meadow roots are nontoxic food. I have no equipment initially; any required equipment or heat must actually be obtained before use.
args.inputs: Known-safe gathered food; other ingredients and equipment requirements are unknown.
args.costs: Time, effort, ingredients and any heat or equipment costs must be specified; currently unknown.
args.effects: Produce an edible prepared meal with stated nutrition and any evidence-based preparation effects; do not assume that requesting grants mastery or creates equipment.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"ivo\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"The related-capability searches found eat and gather, but neither prepares ingredients into a reusable prepared-food product; probe performs observations or small trials rather than meal production. Develop the smallest feasible general food-preparation operation: portion and hand-combine already edible ingredients without heat or equipment. This can make a substantial meal from Ivo's actual berries without inventing tools, fuel, cooking benefits or mastery. Unavailable mechanisms remain in the current-conversation development handoff, not a permanent rejection.\",\"specification\":\"Implement a general Prepare food operation parameterized by ingredient stack IDs, quantities and supported preparation mode, initially cold portion/combine. Before implementation, reconcile the retained registry search results with full implementation contracts in the existing development handoff; if an equivalent parameterized operation exists, reuse its code and record that dependency rather than implement a duplicate. Reuse inventory transfer, food properties, decay, work scheduling and eat contracts. Inputs must be real, accessible, actor-owned edible ingredients with applicable known safety evidence; nontoxicity alone does not establish that an otherwise inedible material is ready to eat. Cold preparation requires usable hands and the ability to handle the selected food, but no vessel, water, fuel or fabricated tool. No washing, cutting, heating, sterilization, detoxification, preservation or digestibility improvement is implied. Other modes require their actual implemented mechanisms and physical prerequisites, not an automatic unlock. Reference Ivo's berry knowledge record berry, nutrition 8 and toxicity 0, and owned stack item-3-ivo-30, resource berry, quantityTenths 30, quantity 3. Validate its live quantity, accessibility and condition at execution. Preparing all three units would produce one three-unit berry meal with nominal total nutrition 24 and zero recorded berry toxicity, subject to existing food-condition rules. The substantial-meal threshold is 8 nutrition; preparing food does not itself feed the actor. The observed root sources, including commons-root-5-0 and start-1-roots, are not owned ingredients: reaching and gathering them must occur separately under navigate and gather, with actual stock and energy costs. Do not expose unobserved stock. Accept positive tenths-unit quantities. Work required equals selected ingredient quantity in simulation time units at one unit per round, with energy cost 1 per ingredient unit worked; a three-unit batch therefore takes three active rounds and 3 energy, in addition to any travel, gathering, learning or eventual eating costs. Validate sufficient energy for each work increment; do not overdraw. At start atomically transfer selected quantities into a real work-in-progress container, preserving ownership, mass, provenance, nutrition, toxicity and decay history. It is a bookkeeping/product container, not a granted physical utensil. Record recipe, inputs, paid work, elapsed progress and position. Progress requires actual actor participation; no unattended preparation or review-time progress. On completion atomically replace the reserved ingredients with a portable edible prepared-food stack carrying the same total ingredient mass and food properties; no free stock or nutrition multiplier. Preserve component age/decay and use existing spoilage rules without refreshing shelf life. Fractional consumption must debit corresponding ingredient quantities and nutrition consistently. Use eat for consumption, including its 1-energy cost, existing satiety limits and actual toxicity effects; never increase basic nutrition because of mood. Interrupted work retains paid progress and real ingredients, which continue to decay. Resume only after revalidating access, condition, hands and energy. Cancellation returns the remaining real ingredient quantities and their current condition, not fresh replacements, spent energy or elapsed time. Death stops work and uses existing death/drop ownership rules for the actual unfinished food; it neither finishes the meal nor duplicates or refunds it. Spoiled or lost inputs cannot support completion. Cold prepared food has no ongoing fuel or equipment maintenance, but ordinary carrying, storage, decay and exposure rules continue. Record all transitions and executable validation rules in code; do not require repeated model approval. Implementation/review waiting advances no world time.\",\"learning\":1,\"experienceReview\":\"Ivo must individually complete one simulation round of study through learn after implementation; request, review, naming, registration and study/mastery award no experiential benefit. Preparation changes food organization, not its nutritional potency. Any pleasure or satisfaction must be tied to an actual personally applicable event, principally eating acceptable food, not merely requesting or producing a labeled meal. Apply the established experience policy in code: use substantialNutrition=8 and mealWindow=10 on actual consumption, deduplicate raw ingredients and their prepared form as the same nutritional event, and do not stack preparation and eating rewards for the same event. Ivo currently has satiety 92.4, so nominal meal nutrition does not guarantee equivalent usable nourishment or an additional comfort benefit. Any supported meal pleasure is brief, capped and subject to the ten-round window; maintained satisfaction may use the established mentalRate 0.04 and mentalDecay 0.002 only within its existing bounded account and applicability rules. If no executable bounded reward rule exists, defer that reward mechanism to the same handoff rather than mint an unspecified bonus. Familiar legitimate meal preparation and eating may qualify without novelty. Verified new information, including informative failure, may qualify only when an actual observation establishes it, not for invoking the operation. Physical comfort remains capped at 10. Do not alter protected reward accounts, budgets, goals or permissions, and do not reduce basic nutrition for low mood.\",\"visualReview\":\"Emit observable preparation-start, progress, pause, resume, cancel, failure and completion events, with actor, work ID, actual input references, quantities, position, progress and timestamp. Completion must reference the created product and occur only after successful atomic input conversion. Provide reusable visual metadata for work-in-progress and prepared-food stacks: component food, mode cold-combined, ingredient resource IDs and proportions, quantity, condition, state, progress and a derived ingredient palette. Show hand preparation only during real work; show the completed meal only when it exists. Do not depict a bowl, utensils, fire, steam or cooked texture without corresponding real objects and processes. Interrupted, failed or incomplete work remains visibly unfinished; eating visuals and effects require a real eat event. Visual labels and presentation confer no safety, nutrition, experience or mastery.\"}]}"}
